result.instructions: Tools for PerfectView, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the relation for 'Van Dijk Installatie' and show me its latest notes."; "Add a note to that relation: 'Quote sent on Friday, follow up next week.'"; "List the products in our PerfectView database.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PerfectView data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run perfectview_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run perfectview_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run perfectview_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. perfectview_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: perfectview_search_relations
tools.title: Search relations
tools.description: Search the relations (customers, leads and companies) in the PerfectView database by name, one page at a time. Use it to find the relation_id that other tools need. SOAP: RelationSearchByName_V2.

name.description: Part of the name to search for.

include_fields.description: Include the custom field values (default false).

include_counters.description: Include the counters, such as activity totals (default false).

tools.name: perfectview_get_relation
tools.title: Get a relation
tools.description: Get one relation by its GUID, optionally with its custom field values and counters. SOAP: RelationGet.

include_fields.description: Include the custom field values (default false).

include_counters.description: Include the counters, such as activity totals (default false).

tools.name: perfectview_get_relation_notes
tools.title: Get relation notes
tools.description: List the notes written on one relation. SOAP: RelationGetNotes.

tools.name: perfectview_add_relation_note
tools.title: Add a note to a relation
tools.description: Write a new note on one relation in PerfectView. It is saved at once and cannot be undone through this tool. SOAP: RelationAddNote.

text.description: The note text (plain text, 1 to 4000 characters).

annotations.title: Add a note to a relation
